question: Given that $8^{-1} \equiv 85 \pmod{97}$, find $64^{-1} \pmod{97}$, as a residue modulo 97.  (Give an answer between 0 and 96, inclusive.)
solution:
Since 8·85≡1 (mod 97), squaring gives 64·85²≡1 (mod 97). Thus 85² is an inverse of 64. To reduce it, use 85≡−12 (mod 97), so 85²≡144≡144−97=47 (mod 97).
Final answer: 47
